note: AI by-eye labels (Claude, 2026-11-17), NOT the researcher's. Units are blobs of DAY/instances_v2/blobs (seg_r04_ft4 raw mask, 8-connected, 2560-px frame), i.e. every label names a pixel region the live segmentation calls whale. Sources: (1) blind contact sheets (model_fine_tuning/seg_real/sample.py, tiles show no score; 1 467 tiles, sheet 1 by the coordinating agent, sheets 2-53 by six labelling sub-agents with one written guide, scratchpad LABEL_GUIDE.md), (2) reused without a new look: instances_v2 blob_labels_ai*.json (whale_part / second_whale -> whale, person, drone, boat, shore), view_class/view_labels.json codes F/D/O and stage2_linker/nw_labels.json pos -> whale, attached through DAY/instances_v2/mapping.json when the old instance maps to one blob holding >= half of it. AI labels 'splash' / 'other' / 'unclear' and nw 'neg' were drawn again on the sheets. 'sure' = the labeller's confidence; unsure share on the sheets 49% (mostly splash vs wake and faint dark strips whale vs water). role = how training uses it (whale only when sure). subtype (splash / wake / whale_splash blobs only) = a second by-eye pass on the kind of white water (breach_slap, back_wash, travel_wake, blow, fluke_stream, whitecap, boat_wake, foam_other, not_white_water) by two sub-agents, 87 % of them marked unsure (mostly back_wash vs travel_wake).

categories.whale_splash: whale under / behind splash (whale + white water mixed)
